name: R. Dandekar

Dandekar': Raj Abhijit Dandekar and Rajat Dandekar, both affiliated with Vizuara AI Labs. The repo seed data confirms the conflation: seed/cdeval_pool.json lists 'R. Dandekar' twice under one and the same Semantic Scholar authorId 2320313160, and that S2 author record maps to DBLP identities ['Raj Abhijit Dandekar','Raj Dandekar','Rajat Dandekar'] - i.e. two separate researchers merged into one row. Anchors found but not usable for disambiguation: LinkedIn linkedin.com/in/raj-abhijit-dandekar-67a33118a (Vizuara, MIT PhD) exists and is a genuine Vizuara person, but attaching it would arbitrarily pick one of the two co-authors; Rajat Dandekar is an equally valid referent. Email: the full arXiv HTML of 2410.01811v1 was fetched and grepped - it prints NO email address for any author, only the shared 'Vizuara AI Labs' affiliation, and no per-person address was found on a printed source; a templated or org-level guess is forbidden. Recommendation: split this row into two people before enrichment. | RESOLVED THIS ROUND (identity, not contact): the arXiv PDF title page of 2410.01811 (extracted directly; the HTML conversion drops it) prints six authors all at footnote 1 'Vizuara AI Labs': 'Fiifi Dawson1, Zainab Mosunmola1, Sahil Pocker1, Raj Abhijit Dandekar1, Rajat Dandekar1, and Sreedath Panat1'. So this row conflates TWO DISTINCT PEOPLE, both at Vizuara AI Labs. Cause confirmed in the repo's own seed (research/seed/cdeval_pool.json): Semantic Scholar returns authorId 2320313160 TWICE in this paper's author list, once per Dandekar, so the collapse happened upstream in S2, not in the pipeline. No email is printed anywhere in the PDF (regex over 4.57M extracted chars found zero addresses). FOR THE ROW SPLIT, both LinkedIn profiles are identified and anchored by Vizuara co-founder posts naming both men: Raj Abhijit Dandekar = https://www.linkedin.com/in/raj-abhijit-dandekar-67a33118a/ and Rajat Dandekar = https://in.linkedin.com/in/rajat-dandekar-901324b1 . linkedin_url is deliberately left 'not found' because this single row cannot represent two people; assigning either URL here would be wrong.
